mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.login_id AS loginId, m.member_name AS memberName, m.email AS email, m.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM tb_member m LEFT JOIN tb_member_dormant_notice n ON n.member_id = m.member_id AND n.stage = #{stage} WHERE m.delete_yn = 'N' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.last_login_at IS NOT NULL AND m.last_login_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{cutoffDays} DAY) AND n.notice_id IS NULL

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.login_id AS loginId, m.member_name AS memberName, m.email AS email, m.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM tb_member m WHERE m.delete_yn = 'N' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.last_login_at IS NOT NULL AND m.last_login_at <= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{cutoffDays} DAY)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_member_dormant_notice (notice_id, member_id, stage, sent_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at) VALUES (uuid_v7(), #{memberId}, #{stage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'SYSTEM', '127.0.0.1', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
